lines.say: 42 diagram types / in your own brand, / in 60 seconds.
A skill for / Claude Code, Codex, / Copilot, Droid and Pi. / No generic rounded boxes.
Its maker used / to fight Figma / for 30 minutes, / or skip the diagram.

shots.sub: fighting Figma, or no diagram at all

lines.say: Now the agent draws / architecture maps, flowcharts, / Sankey, fishbone, Wardley maps, / even exploded / axonometric views.
Give it your website. / It reads the palette / and the font stack, / then maps them / to roles: / paper, ink and accent.
It shows the diff, / writes your tokens, / and every new diagram / wears your colors.
Then it checks contrast / against WCAG AA / and proposes fixes.
Old draw.io, Mermaid / or Excalidraw files? / It redraws them / at your chosen detail.
Faithful keeps / up to 24 nodes, / balanced 12, / simplified 7. / A ledger lists / what got dropped.
45.7k stars. / Every pull request / is checked on Linux, / Windows and macOS.
Install takes two commands: / add the marketplace, / then the plugin.
Send this to someone / who still fights Figma / for every diagram.
diagram-design. / Editorial diagrams / your designer won't hate.
